notes.title: Major update!
notes.content:
[b]List of changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added new music for the base
[*] Corrected operation of pointers. Now, if an enemy behind you shoots, you will see a sign
[*] Fixed weapon damage balance
[*] Fixed enemy power balance
[*] Improved enemy AI
[*] Improved enemy animation
[*] Enemies will now target you just like you
[*] The health system has been improved, now you and enemies will receive damage in the same system.
[*] Fixed bugs on the ground
[*] Community bugs fixed
[*] Dropped loot will now disappear over time
[*] The loading screen system has been improved, you will now see the level being loaded, the viewing time and the difficulty of the level.
[*] Changed post effects system for future updates
[*] Enemy lasers no longer pass through walls or you.
[*] Destroyed enemies will disappear smoothly
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog 3 - Elemental Damage and Explosive Barrels
notes.content:
Every elemental weapon now has a chance to inflict elemental damage. Each of them gives unique damage to the enemy and interacts with other elemental damage.

Added 6 types of explosive barrels, they will be randomly located on levels, each of which explodes and deals its own elemental damage.

Fixed a bug with the loading screen, now it is displayed correctly. Also added tooltips, current floor name and loading progress percentage.

Added a sound and visual effect for the drop chest. Now you definitely won't be able to resist him.

Minor level changes. Corrected the balance of enemy spawning, increased the space for battle in some rooms.

Fixed bugs related to crashes from games, screen freezes, crashes during loading.

Fixed mouse bug when selecting weapons and implants.

Fixed bugs with button hints after changing the keyboard layout.

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Turrets explode.
[*] If the enemy dies, he will stop attacking, and already launched attack phases will be stopped.
[*] Added 2 new arena rooms.
[*] Now select skills will show mixed skills when leveling up.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44046849/9e21f1321ada3997dc5c7a198eaa28d28540ffeb.png[/img]
[*] Cases now show which items and abilities the player has dropped, as well as their description.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44046849/929535815eaa4d38f68211a50c3eb79ff56160b0.png[/img]
[*] If you don't have this weapon or implant, it will show up as new in the leftover selection and in the case.
[*] Added an indicator of the effectiveness of elemental weapons against each type of health.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44046849/e8d1c23523ee8212b5e1f9d3e2c110f4d2df335c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44046849/1d7417c3a79b6477a8dc56124c05145e809186fa.png[/img]
[*] Added button to go to office employees in pause.
[/list]

notes.title: The first major update is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161756/4424f0a15f744b348576a1d2685a3b56e4f73378.gif[/img]

[b]Characters[/b]
I added a character system to the game! You can now select and buy new characters before the start of the race.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161756/03fe5acec4d4328ba61da7d72c22970310ec68b5.png[/img]

Each character has their own starting weapon and stats. Someone is fast and strong, and someone has a stronger weapon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161756/79f6ef4d6d08bf4fe11f2178a07e440b5a0dd685.png[/img]

Most of the characters are not available. They need to be rescued during the run. To do this, the game has a new room. If you clear and save the character, then after the race you can buy it and play as it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161756/5392b6474e8b3ad00d1ecf85c4dc1eae7a884c06.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44161756/17bb6773bf66d32f6f27f426ee3bfb485d9eef2c.png[/img]

I also read the reviews and made corrections in the update:
[list]
[*] Dash Buffed by 30% but cooldown is 30% longer
[*] Increased shotgun starting damage by 50%
[*] Pistol recoil reduced by 75%
[*] Minigun barrel rotation acceleration speed increased by 100%
[*] Now the player does not take damage if he is not in the gameplay with weapons
[*] Crosshair when aiming syncs faster and becomes centered, speed increased by 1500%
[*] Fixed sticky running, now it turns off correctly
[/list]

I have many more updates, fixes and additions to the game in my plans. You can join beta testers or buy the game. The choice is yours, the main thing is to be with us!
